verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Superhuman Mail MCP as a server that lets external assistants like Claude and ChatGPT drive the inbox. That is the opposite direction from this story: nothing shows Superhuman Mail itself can add third-party MCP servers and call their tools. Mentions of agents that use 'the work you connect' and 'connector permissions' are adjacent features and do not name MCP-client support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
